# Website Structure

This document describes the purpose and content boundaries of the main sections of maximerancon.com. Use it as a reference when adding or reorganizing pages and navigation.

## Sections

### Home (`/`)

The concise overview of the professional profile. It introduces the author's skills and experience and provides contact and social links. Keep this page focused and avoid duplicating the detailed project content from the other sections.

### Video (`/video`)

The multimedia portfolio, including video and other creative projects. Content should demonstrate both creative work and the technical skills used to produce it.

### Development (`/dev`)

Software development projects, including the technologies used, problems solved, and project outcomes. This section showcases technical ability and software problem-solving.

### Automation (`/automation`)

Automation projects and experiments, including the tools used, processes improved, and results achieved. Content may cover scripting, programming, and system integration.

### Artificial Intelligence (`/ai`)

AI-related projects and experiments. Content should show practical applications of AI for improving processes and using AI tools in multimedia production.
